title: Sec 2 G3 Chinese
description: Secondary 2 G3 (Express) Chinese Language (MOE 2021 secondary MTL syllabus; SEAB SEC G3 Chinese K320 format): 综合填空, 词语替换, 阅读理解一 on practical texts and news, 阅读理解二 open answers on narrative and informative passages. English-first coaching around Chinese content, vocabulary cards.

archetypes.pattern: 综合填空 words: options share a character or a word class (特地/特殊/独特); the collocation or word class decides (关系融洽, an adverb before a verb)
关联词 in a passage: the partner word later in the sentence (不但……而且, 只要……就) or the turn between two clauses (但是)
成语 in a passage: the clause after the blank shows the attitude or reaction (竟然……！ → 大吃一惊)
词语替换: five numbered, underlined words misused in one passage — wrong collocation (反应冷淡), near-synonym (增加/提高), opposite meaning (表扬/批评), wrong sense (采用/发明)
传单／广告: what is accepted or not, costs and who pays, conditions, the purpose of a rule
新闻报道: the main point (导语), what happens if, why (from a quoted speaker)
记叙文: find-a-word from a named paragraph, reasons across paragraphs, the point of a character's action, the meaning of a key line, feelings change with evidence
说明文: what a figurative phrase refers to, list the points signposted by 首先／其次／此外, the author's view plus the learner's own action
实用文: reply to an email or write one from given material, covering every point, 150+ characters, choose one of two
作文 (40 marks): 300+ characters, choose one of three; 记叙文, 说明文 or 议论文
